description: The shared contract vocabulary for the county learning runtime and both pack validators (rebuild plan, 'Automated enforcement'). Runtime and validator enums are checked against this one documented list so a pack cannot pass offline and fail after decoding. Parity: CountyContractValidationTests on the Swift side, tools/tests/test_validate_county_pack.py on the Python side.

notes.responseFamilies: CountyExerciseFamily cases whose learner action answers with target language. Conversation is a D27 distribution container, but its learner turns are a response method, so it lists here.
notes.pureContainers: CountyExerciseFamily cases that host or end activities without their own answer method: completion states capabilities, contextual review re-enters an embedded exercise that carries the response method. responseFamilies and pureContainers together enumerate every CountyExerciseFamily case.
notes.authoredUses: The D27 authored uses declared on CountyExercise.authoredUse; there is no runtime enum, so the parity test asserts this documented list.
